Declare a deferred artifact writer

Source: R/artifact-plan.R
reflow_artifact_stage.Rd

This additive API permits reflow_artifact_ref() in ordinary arguments. Static declarations are validated immediately; future artifact paths are resolved only after their producers have been authenticated. Scientific methods remain in trusted installed exports. No writer runs here.

Usage

reflow_artifact_stage(
  id,
  package,
  fun,
  args = list(),
  outputs,
  inventory,
  allow_empty = character(),
  seed = NULL,
  packages = character(),
  runtime_files = character()
)

Arguments

id

Unique stage identifier.

package, fun, args, outputs, inventory, allow_empty, seed, packages, runtime_files

See reflow_artifact_spec().

Value

A deferred writer declaration.
